facts.text: Rooster, the orphans can have gruel again tonight. You and me are eating steak, on Warbucks's reward money.
facts.why: No quote page for the film was opened. The line is not in any plot summary, and it clashes with the story, where Rooster and Lily only scheme to claim the reward. Printed in quote marks and signed Miss Hannigan. Her song 'Little Girls' opens with 'little girls' and 'everywhere I turn'.

fix_note.text: Rooster, orphans get gruel again tonight. Once we collect Warbucks's reward, you and me eat steak.

facts.text: Grace orders it all for Annie's first night.
facts.why: In the transcript Grace asks Mrs. Pugh if dinner is under way, and Mrs. Pugh is making Warbucks's favourite; nobody orders food for Annie.
facts.fix: Grace checks on dinner with Mrs. Pugh.

facts.text: Annie's order, a night at Radio City.
facts.why: Warbucks sends Annie and Grace to Radio City Music Hall to see Camille, but no one places an order there.
facts.fix: Annie's night out at Radio City.

facts.text: The bodyguard's favourite, made the way he likes it.
facts.why: Punjab is one of Warbucks's bodyguards, but nothing shows him eating lamb curry; what he does is fly in by helicopter to rescue Annie.
facts.fix: the bodyguard who flies in by helicopter when it counts

vibe.verdict: A neat mansion room service card with Hannigan's note, Punjab's curry and Radio City, but Leaping lizards no longer prints and the writing is gentle.
